name: Clingmans Dome
summary: Concrete observation tower on the TN-NC line, now called Kuwohi Observation Tower; built 1959 by the NPS with a fire cab that was dropped; NRHP-listed 2012; reached on foot.
design: Reinforced concrete observation tower by Bebb and Olson, 45 ft tall, with a 375 ft spiral ramp to the platform; an enclosed fire lookout cab planned in early designs was removed
agency: National Park Service, Great Smoky Mountains National Park

access.note: Visitors walk up on a paved, very steep trail from the Kuwohi parking area; NPS describes a 1-mile round trip. Seasonal road and tower hours not confirmed.

visit.trail_note: Drive to the Kuwohi parking area, then a steep half-mile paved walk; the ramp lets visitors climb gradually to the platform

events.note: Low bid of $57,000 by W.C. Norris Construction Co., Waynesville, N.C., for an observation tower on Clingmans Dome, reported in a 1958 Kingsport Times item quoted by Forest Lookouts
Concrete observation tower built 1959 under the Mission 66 program (NPS; NC nomination says constructed in 1959)
Marker caption says visitors had climbed a wooden tower before the concrete tower was completed in 1960; ramp wall work shown in 1959
Listed on the National Register of Historic Places 15 August 2012
